job.job_description:
Overview

We are seeking a LLM Engineer (Large Language Model Engineer) that will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and operationalizing Large Language Model capabilities that power data understanding, reasoning, and insight generation across AI products.

We are building next-generation Generative AI products that deliver actionable data insights at enterprise scale. Our platform leverages Large Language Models (LLMs), advanced data pipelines, and AI agents to help organizations reason over data, generate insights, and make informed decisions. We focus on building secure, scalable, explainable, and production-grade AI systems.

Location
Bangalore, India (Hybrid; 3 days onsite/2 days remote)

What You ll Do:

Design, develop, and maintain LLM-based workflows for data analysis and insight generation
Build prompt strategies, templates, and system instructions for reliable and accurate model behavior
Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and multi-step reasoning workflows
Evaluate and improve model quality, latency, and cost efficiency
Collaborate with data, knowledge, and applied AI engineers to improve grounding and relevance
Develop and optimize prompts and workflows for complex data reasoning use cases
Continuously test and evaluate model outputs for accuracy, consistency, and bias
Optimize token usage, response time, and cost without compromising quality
Contribute to best practices for LLM usage and responsible AI development
Support production deployments and troubleshoot LLM-related issues

What We re Looking For:

Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
6 9 years of experience in software engineering, AI, or NLP-related roles
Experience working with Generative AI or NLP systems in production environments
Exposure to enterprise data or analytics platforms is a plus
Strong experience working with Large Language Models and LLM APIs
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering and prompt optimization
Good understanding of embeddings, semantic search, and RAG architectures
Proficiency in Python and AI/ML development frameworks
Familiarity with model evaluation, experimentation, and monitoring techniques

Technical Skills Required:

Core Skills

Python
LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic)
